scripts.predev: npm run build:cv-data && npm run sync-assets
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.sync-assets: mkdir -p apps/web-cv/public && rm -rf apps/web-cv/public/photo apps/web-cv/public/certificates 'apps/web-cv/public/HTB Academy Student Transcript.pdf' && ln -sfn ../../../legacy/photo apps/web-cv/public/photo && ln -sfn ../../../legacy/certificates apps/web-cv/public/certificates && ln -sfn '../../../legacy/HTB Academy Student Transcript.pdf' 'apps/web-cv/public/HTB Academy Student Transcript.pdf'
scripts.prebuild: npm run build:cv-data && npm run sync-assets
scripts.build: npm --workspace ./apps/web-cv run build && npm --workspace ./apps/api-cv run build
